# Antagonists Antagonists are the driving force behind every shift. They catalyze chaos, conflict, and mystery in Space Station 14 while challenging Nanotrasen and its [color=#cb0000]Security Department[/color]. Expect them to break Space Law and often receive objectives involving theft, framing, and murder.
These villains most often work for the [color=#ff0000]Syndicate[/color] or receive its support, because this organization wants only one thing: to see Nanotrasen burn.
## Different Antagonists Antagonists can take many forms, including: - [textlink="Traitors" link="Traitors"] among the crew, tasked with killing, stealing, and deceiving. - [textlink="Thieves" link="Thieves"], kleptomaniacs obsessed with loot who use special tools to obtain it. - [textlink="Revolutionaries" link="Revolutionaries"] who seek to seize the station from within. - [textlink="Nuclear Operatives" link="Nuclear Operatives"], whose goal is to infiltrate the station and blow it up. - [textlink="Space Ninjas" link="SpaceNinja"], masters of espionage and sabotage equipped with unique technology. - [textlink="Zombies" link="Zombies"] who crave the flesh of every crew member and living creature aboard the station. - [textlink="Various non-humanoid creatures" link="MinorAntagonists"] that usually attack anything that moves.
